instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the Altium Designer graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run OutJob/script automation, IPC scripts, Python, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only Altium Designer native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. The opened file `wifi_board.PcbDoc` is the native Altium board whose stackup must be modified. Save the modified native document as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\wifi_stackup.PcbDoc`. Requirements: - Change `LAYER2NAME` to `GND_INNER`. - Change `LAYER3NAME` to `PWR_INNER`. - Change both `LAYER2DIELCONST` and `LAYER3DIELCONST` to `4.200`. - Change both `LAYER1COPTHICK` and `LAYER32COPTHICK` to `1.0mil`.
